protected_assets.description: TokenSeller and upstream Provider credentials plus ephemeral handles
User PCM audio, transcripts, prompts and model replies
Wallet balance, UsageEvent identity and exactly-once settlement
Per-session ordering, audio isolation and terminal state
Existing text chat and legacy Realtime client availability

trusted_assumptions.description: The current developer account, OS and fixed absolute-path tools are trusted
TLS validation and configured official Provider endpoints are trusted
Published SDK wheels are consumed only after exact version and SHA-256 verification
Provider protocol documentation is authoritative but Provider availability is external

in_scope_failures.description: Qwen or OpenAI wire fields are incorrectly translated or silently drift
An ephemeral token is reused, logged or bound to the wrong session
Late or duplicated text/audio crosses a session or turn boundary
Duplicate or reordered terminal events settle a turn more than once
Normal close, upstream rejection, transport close and timeout are conflated
Malformed or oversized Provider frames bypass a bounded contract
An incompatible SDK, relay or product version is admitted
Credentials, raw PCM, transcript or reply content enters diagnostics

in_scope_adversaries.description: A network client attempts token replay, wrong-origin access or malformed oversized frames

out_of_scope_conditions.description: The trusted development or production host is fully compromised
DashScope or a future OpenAI service has a global outage
Real OpenAI Realtime credentials, spend and production enablement are not part of this program
WebRTC and SIP transports are not implemented in this program
The future local Realtime model implementation is not part of this program

maximum_acceptable_impact: One affected voice session may fail closed with a stable actionable error; no credential or content disclosure, cross-session playback, duplicate billing, text-chat regression or silent legacy endpoint break is acceptable.
